title: Audit and consolidate docker/scripts helper scripts
description:
docker/scripts/ has accumulated overlapping helper scripts across three work waves: quick_test.sh, quick_test_docker.sh, quick_test_k8s.sh, start-full-stack.sh (May 28-29), demo_k8s.sh, demo_k8s_batch.sh (June 5), setup_envoy_gateway_poc.sh, build_k8s_images.sh (June 10+). The three quick_test variants share near-identical purpose and the older scripts predate the Envoy Gateway path.

Audit each script: purpose, which deployment mode it serves (SQS, Celery, scoring-api), whether it still runs against the current chart/values, and overlap with newer scripts. Delete stale ones, merge near-duplicates (e.g. one quick_test with a --target docker|k8s flag), and add a short docker/scripts/README.md inventory so future contributors (human or agent) extend instead of spawning new variants. Keep setup_envoy_gateway_poc.sh and build_k8s_images.sh as-is; they are current.
